description: Register every number the answer or report cites in facts.json. A table fact (add) is one cell of a saved CSV: table (exhibits/<x>.csv, data/<id>/<t>.csv or published/<x>.csv), where (the row's key values, matched to the CSV's own text) and column; its value is read from the cell. A derived fact (derived) has a derivation: written as an expression over fact names ("deaths_2024 / deaths_2020 - 1") it is computed here, so leave value out; a prose derivation needs value. Refuses empty cells and NaN, an ambiguous pack, unknown formats and units slips (a share given to pct100, millions given to usd_b ...); nothing is saved when any fact is refused. Returns this call's facts with their text (the value as the answer prints it: quote it exactly) and notes (rounding ties); with no arguments, every fact registered so far. fmt codes: raw, num:0, pct:1 (share 0-1), pct100:1 (already percent), pp:1, pp100:1, bp:0, dollars:0, thousands:-3, millions:1, billions:1, usd_b:1 (value in dollars), usd_b_scaled:1 (already billions), ratio:2, index:1, year; prefixes signed:, abs:, from_millions: ...; suffix :abs. pack is inferred from data/<id>/ or the exhibit's lineage.
